answers.reason: I predict denial because the 'parting with possession' route is defeated by the supported concurrent user evidence, while the 'subletting' and 'assignment' routes remain unproven. The statutory ground requires one of the three routes to be established; since the only viable route (parting with possession) is negated by the concurrent user defense, the ground is not made out.
